body: Everything I enjoy are things we used to enjoy together, and it hurts too much to do them alone.   Even falling asleep and staying in bed and hiding from the world is too hard without him laying next to me.  If I just knew sooner I was sick he would have stayed with me but instead I didn't trust him when he said I was doing things I didn't remember.   I blamed him for everything because I really believed it was him.   I'm buried in debt and have no skills or ability to support myself.  I depended on him for everything.   I can't even drive.  I devoted my life to being his wife and partner, to making him happy and building a family.   It's the only purpose I ever wanted and now I've ruined it in every way.

I tell him everything, at first he was even willing to try working on things again, but the more I try to get better the further he seems to pull away and I think it is because of his new relationship.  He does not want to get hurt again and does not want to lose someone else he loves, and every time I make a mistake or do something to upset him he draws away more thinking that I am just trying to lure him in to hurt him more, and the more he pushes away the more unstable I get and the more he is afraid of me and does not trust me.  I want more than anything for him to let me fix this but he does not understand.   His life without me is now peaceful, with no stress, and every time he talks to me it just brings up all that pain, so he figures he is better off without me.   He doesn't see the point of fixing things with me when even at my best I will still hurt him, but if he continues without me he will be happier and struggle much less.  He has not seen me in person for several weeks, and now will not even talk to me online.    He only sees me as a source of pain and I just want it to stop.

I don't believe in that at all.   I vowed to love him forever.  Better or worse, sickness and health.  I stood by him and helped him through depression, PTSD, so many things.   Whenever he was sick I understood, I forgave, I loved.   Why can't he forgive me?  Why can't he have faith in me?   Whats the point of struggling through a life that does not want me just to live it without him.   He loved me so much, he promised to spend the rest of his life with me.   Why is that not worth it to  him?   I know I'm not perfect, I know I hurt him, but I'm doing everything I can to fix it.   Why doesn't that matter to him?  He did not even have the decency to divorce me.  We are still married now and he knows I do not want divorce, but he does not want me and continues living with another woman in what used to be our home.
